title: Demand Service Rate Programs: What a Second Technician on a Call Is Billed At
content:
*More than one technician worked a demand call under the Demand Service Rate Programs. What is billed for the ones beyond the lead?*

Where the call record shows more than one technician on a call taken at emergency or critical priority,
each technician beyond the lead is billed at the tier's second journeyman rate for the hours charged
for. Where it shows more than one technician on a call taken at routine or priority, each technician
beyond the lead is billed at the tier's apprentice rate for the hours charged for. Where the call record
shows one technician, nothing further is billed for technicians beyond the lead.

*Which two figures are those?*

| Program | Second journeyman rate (USD per hour) | Apprentice rate (USD per hour) |
|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 155 | 92 |
| Priority Response Program | 144 | 88 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 138 | 84 |
| Emergency Response Program | 132 | 80 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 126 | 78 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 120 | 74 |

*Where are the priority and the technician count read from?*

The priority is the classification the call was taken at, as the dispatch record carries it; the count
is the number of technicians the completion record of the call shows.

*How do the two conditions sit together?*

| Technicians the call record shows | Priority the call was taken at | Each technician beyond the lead |
|---|---|---|
| one | any | nothing further is billed |
| more than one | emergency | the second journeyman rate |
| more than one | critical | the second journeyman rate |
| more than one | routine | the apprentice rate |
| more than one | priority | the apprentice rate |

*An illustration.* On the Priority Response Program, a call taken at critical priority worked by two
technicians bills the technician beyond the lead at 144 US dollars an hour for the hours charged for;
the same two technicians on a call taken at routine priority bill that technician at 88 US dollars an
hour.
